description: This is a Java unit test class for MainMethodExceptionHandler, testing exception handling, immutability, and logging behavior.

classes.name: MainMethodExceptionHandlerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for MainMethodExceptionHandler, verifying exception handling, immutability, and logging.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the mock logger and the instance of MainMethodExceptionHandler for testing.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that MainMethodExceptionHandler instances are immutable and that the Logger is also immutable.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullLogger
methods.description: Verifies that passing null to getInstance throws a NullPointerException with the expected message.

methods.name: tryToRunNullRunnable
methods.description: Checks that calling call(null) throws a NullPointerException with appropriate message.

methods.name: nothingIsLoggedIfRunnableThrowsNoException
methods.description: Ensures no logs are produced when the runnable passed to call() executes without exceptions.

methods.name: exceptionIsReThrownAndLoggedAppropriately
methods.description: Verifies that an exception thrown within the runnable is re-thrown and logged correctly.

methods.name: errorIsReThrownAndLoggedAppropriately
methods.description: Checks that an Error thrown within the runnable is re-thrown and logged correctly.
